name: A shred of evidence

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

summary: A crumpled note points toward the fragments Windsor needs. The search passes through the forge and deeper chambers of Blackrock Mountain, where small pieces of a document matter more than the strength of the gates. Recovered evidence gives Windsor grounds to leave his cell and face the city again. This is the work of a rescue and an investigation together: one carries the other back into the light.
